def transform(grid):
    # Find each rectangle's color frame and make the interior checkerboard in that color.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for c in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{0}:
        pts={(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[y][x]==c}
        # one component per shape
        while pts:
            seed=pts.pop(); comp={seed}; st=[seed]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                for q in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
                    if q in pts: pts.remove(q); comp.add(q); st.append(q)
            ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]; t,b,l,r=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            # internal specks specify which checker parity to fill
            interior=[(y,x) for y,x in comp if t<y<b and l<x<r]
            if interior:
                parity=(interior[0][0]+interior[0][1])%2
                for y in range(t+1,b):
                    for x in range(l+1,r):
                        if (y+x)%2==parity: out[y][x]=c
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Extract rectangle borders and their interior masks.
    frames=[]
    for c in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v):
        pts={(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[y][x]==c}
        while pts:
            seed=pts.pop(); comp={seed}; st=[seed]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                for q in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
                    if q in pts: pts.remove(q); comp.add(q); st.append(q)
            ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            t,b,l,r=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            if all((t,x) in comp and (b,x) in comp for x in range(l,r+1)) and all((y,l) in comp and (y,r) in comp for y in range(t,b+1)):
                frames.append((c,t,b,l,r))
    patterned=[]
    for c,t,b,l,r in frames:
        mask=[[grid[y][x]==c for x in range(l+1,r)] for y in range(t+1,b)]
        if any(any(row) for row in mask): patterned.append((c,t,b,l,r,mask))
    if not patterned: return out
    # Source is the frame with the most interior marks; copy its mask to empty equal-size frames.
    src=max(patterned,key=lambda z:sum(sum(row) for row in z[5]))
    sc,st,sb,sl,sr,sm=src
    for c,t,b,l,r in frames:
        if c==sc: continue
        mh,mw=b-t-1,r-l-1
        if (mh,mw)==(len(sm),len(sm[0])):
            for i in range(mh):
                for j in range(mw):
                    if sm[i][j]: out[t+1+i][l+1+j]=c
    return out

        while pts:

            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()

            t=min(y for y,x in comp); b=max(y for y,x in comp); l=min(x for y,x in comp); r=max(x for y,x in comp)

    sources=[]
